_note: TWO-SUB (Codex + Grok): the user assigned their Codex/GPT surface as the dispatcher — a legitimate, first-class dispatcher assignment for an inventory with no Claude seat. It classifies/briefs/assigns/gates and fans work to the seats it owns; Codex is also the worker/review family here (Terra MCP volume + Sol review). When Grok is spent, the intake Codex plan implements (never-strand, intake-codes-last-resort). Dispatch is user-assigned; adding a Claude seat later would let the user move dispatcher.provider there if they choose.

dispatcher.rule: one dispatcher (the user's assigned Codex/GPT surface); a phone never implements. Dispatch is user-assigned — this inventory has no Claude seat, so the user assigned their Codex plan; it fans work to the seats it owns.

codex-cli.note: the user's assigned dispatcher here; also runs Sol review + MCP volume; the intake plan codes as last resort when Grok is spent

rules.non_dispatcher_hosts: Grok drafts nothing — it implements the dispatched brief
rules.entry_is_free: type from Codex or Grok; the user assigned the single dispatcher to their Codex plan
rules.portability: adding a Claude seat later gives a second review family (cross-family gates stop parking) and the option to reassign dispatcher.provider to it — the user's call, not a demotion of Codex
